tei:div.tei:p: 207) ༄༅/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las/ mkha' 'grau sde lnga'i rten 'brail mo yig snying por dril ba bzhugs so// 208)

༄༅/ rgyal kun gsung gi dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung*// 'khor 'das spyi dpal kun bzang bde ba'i mchog /yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor lha la gus btud nas// mo yig nyung bsdus 'bri la gnang ba stsol/ 'di la bzhi las/ ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ chas rnams tshogs nas/ bdag nyid rta mgrin gsal ba'i spyi gtsug tu// pad 'byung a tsar chas can gzi mdangs ldan// snying gar phag mo mdun rten mkha' 'gro bcur// ye shes pa bstim legs nyes lung bstan bsam/ hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ pra mo shag: pra mo thun: chu bur mig gi go sol phyes: rno mthong gsal ba'i sgron me sbor: zhes bzla/ gnyis pa mo bdar ni/ e ma ho: 'gyur med rgyal po o rgyan rje: rno lha rno gsal thams cad mkhyen: mkha' 'gro mang po'i dbus na bzhugs: snang srid gtan la dbab par mdzod: bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha: mkha' 'grau shugs 'gro bcas pa dang: snang srid lha klu mthu rtsal can: gza' skar 'byung ba lnga yi lha: snang gsal mo la dgyes pa rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: mo rten rdzas mchog mchod pa 'bul: snang gsal mo yi ston pa mdzod: khyed rnams mo 209)yi ston pa ste: bzang ngan gnyis kyi shan 'byedacing: legs nyes rnams kyi ltong gcod mdzod: dmod pa'i mo 'di bstan du gsol: dkon mchog rtsa gsum bden pa dang: chos nyid chos can bslu ba med: bden grub tshogs kyi bden stobs kyis: sgrib med gsal bar myur du phob: gsum pa mo dngos ni/ ༈ sangs rgyas mkha' 'grau la bab na// bstan pa'i chus phywar shin tu bzang*/ khyim phywa lha sman bzang pos 'go /lha mchod sri mnan byas na bzang*// mi nor zas dang longs spyod 'phel/ 'on kyang bdud dang rgyal po 'khri// mchod na mgon dang ma mchod gnod// skyes kyi pho phywar mi chen rgyud// yin na dga' skyid legs po 'ong*/

srog phywar sngar gyi lha gsol na// lo gsum bar du tshe srog sra// srid phywar bu mang tshang brdol nas/ gza' mi skyid la brten yun ring*// bu chung mthun phywar bzang ba'i mchog /nor phywar g.yang skyabs gser 'od dag /'don na bzang phyug dar bar 'ong*// blo phywar bzang grags mi 'grub pa'i// nyen 'dug 'grub na shin tu bzang*/ grogs phywar bsam pa'i don 'grub bzang*// sa cha yul bzung btsan phyug tshod// zin na shin tu dar la phyug khang pa bzung ba'i rtse mo bzang*// zhu ba i gnang gang zhus 'byung*/ 210) /don phywar ci bsam khar ma 'don// sgrub dang ci 'dod 'byung skad do// mgraun po myur 'ong gdan/ thing skad// tshong phywar rgyal drag gcig rgod 'chor// slob dpon 'di bstan shin tu 'phrod// sman pas nad pa mal nas slong*// bu chung sri'u slob dpon 'dir// zhus na myur du gsos par 'gyur// sman dpyad gtar bsregs ma byas legs// nad pa tshe srog lha yi skyobs// da res nad 'dis mi 'chi'o// gdon la ma mo gson 'dres gnod// // /brtan ma'i spyi mdos 'dre mo'i yas// gson 'dre kha ching rnams la gzab// bor gtor 'tshol go chod par rnyed// dmag jag 'gro na ngo so che// rta sogs rmig zlum bcos na 'phrod// rmig pa kha dbrag bcos ka bshol// mdza' bo rnyed kyang mthun ma drag /gseb btang gseb pas go chod na// mo la srid brten gda' skad do// pha raul rtsod pa rang rgyal te/ kho la dmu gab zhwa ltar gda'// chang ni bzhi mdor btsod kyang zhim// bzo yi rigs byed phyi dal du// ma song 'phral phugs gang yang bzang*// lo legs skya rgyal spro ba bskyed/ kha char myur 'bab char zon gyis// rtsed mo mgo thon gtam snyan thos// dkor phywa yon phywa shin tu legs// dgra phywa 211)dgra 'dre byur gsum bral// dgra gcig 'dug pa bros nas thal/ ༈ sangs rgyas shugs 'gro la babs na// chus phywar pha myes rgyud srung gi

/gsol khar 'bad dang 'bring stod tsam/ khyim phywa khang khyim 'dre can du// 'dug pas rgyal 'gong bse rag bkar// pho phywar ma nyes kha yog 'ong*// mkhar las byes la 'gro ba spang*// shi dang 'dra ba'i nad phog srid// srog lus dbang klung bskyed gtod gyis// srid phywar sgab 'dre rgyal 'gong bcas// bshol na legs kyang snang chog bya// srog phywar ngan zhing lus bsgyur gyis// bu mo yas thong ma gtogs ngan// nor phywa bse rags 'khor bas ngan// gser 'od stong dang g.yang skyabs gzob// blo phywa blo de 'dre yis brkus// 'dun ma'i rgya ral don mi 'grub// grogs phywa gzhan la re ma chi// rang nor phyir la shor nyen gda'// yul bzung 'brog mtsher yin na rung*// sa mkhar mi brten 'pho skyas mang*/ khang pa sra la brten pa bzang*// mgron phywar 'bring smad cung tsam ngan// zhu ba mi gnang gnang yang ngan// don phywa don med stong log ngan// mgraun po chus bcad nyer mi 'ong*// tshong phywa ngan pa'i tha ma yin// slob dpon 212)bzang yang las 'brel med// sman pa 'di ni 'phrod pa med// gtar bsreg byas na 'chi bas bshol// cis kyang byas na nad pa la// gos nag thod nag chings la gyis// nad pa tshe nyams gso dka' yang*// dur los spang dag 'bum 'ur 'don// brgya bzhi cho ga dge 'dun bzhis// mdo chog byas na 'tsho skad do// gdon ni shar phyogs rgyal po dang*// zas dkar zhig gi rkyen byas pas// dkar po drug mdos dkar chos bya// bor gtor mi lag dam par chud// dmag jag 'gro na mgo mi thon// rmig zlum phan med skyong dka' zhing*// bcos ka byas kyang ngo so med// rmig dbrag bcos dka' phugs mi phan// mdza' bo mi rnyed rnyed na yang*// gyod dang mi kha mang po 'byung*// gseb btang srid kyi rgya mtsho skam/ rtsod phywa rang gi khe mi thob/ chang ni mi zhim rgyal po la/ ster cha byin na gsum tsam zhim/

bzo nyes snying stong ngo yi bshol/ lo nyes snga bun rgyags brabs mdzod/ kha char rlug 'khrugs char mi 'bab/ rtsed mo rtsod dang chag grum 'byung*// skor phywa g.yon phywa ci nas ngan/ dgra phywa dgra ngo skrag ngo che// dgra bzlog dgra brub dgra sri mnan/ ༈ rdo rje mkha' 'grau la bab na/ chus phywa bla dpon gang yang bzang*/ khyim phywa shin bzang ba'i mchog 213) skyes kyi pho phywa shin tu legs// srog phywatshe ring nad med rab// srid phywa bu tsha glen pa'am// dbang po ma tshang ba yod ngan// mi dang g.yem pas lha mnol phog /bu chung 'go ba'i lha lnga mchod// lo lngar shi chad 'ong mi srid// nor phya zas nor longs spyod 'phel// blo phywa rab kyi nang nas mchog grogs phya phun sum tshogs 'byung bzang*// sa phywa yul 'dzin shin tu bzang*// khang pa lha srung bzang po chags// de dang stun mdzodashin tu legs// zhu ba 'phral du mi 'byung ste// phugs su gnang bas gnyug sring mdzod// don phya phyi dal ma mchod bzang*// phyi dal la ni bag zon mdzod// mgron po zas khur ngo so dang*// skyems bcas 'ong bas rngams ma che// tshong phywa rgyal la tshong ya yang*// sha sngo khong sgril lab skyen 'byung*// slob dpon byin ldan rten 'brel 'dzoms// sman pa gzhan la ma shor bzang*// le'u 'phrod cing shin tu bzang*// gtar sreg shin tu 'phrod par mchi// nad pa nad yun cung zhig byed// klus gnod gdon khrol byas na phan// gdon ni bdud dang brtan ma dang*// ma mo dang ni ri 'dres gnod// bdud kyi zhal bsgyur brtan ma'i mdos// khrag mdos ri 'dre bkar na legs// bor gtor rim gyis rnyed par 'gyur// dmag jag phyin na chog 214)par gda'// rmig zlum bed chod bcos kas phan// rmig dbrag 'phral dge phugs mi phan// bcos ka ma byed rang mal zhog /mdza' bo myur du mi rnyed kyang*// rim gyi gnyer na phugs su phan// gseb chags srid de pho ru 'gyur// rtsod na rang rgyal gtam ngan thob// chang ni gzhan gyis mi mthong bar// srib kyi rdo nag yi ge raṃ// bris pa bcug nas btsos pas zhim// bzo legs bkra shis par 'gyur ro// lo legs bungs dang ldan par 'ong*/

kha char nam mkhar sprin 'khrigs kyang*// che bar mi 'bab bab na than// rtsed mo bzhad gad che mi 'byung*// skor phywa g.yon phywa phyi dal chi// grub na skor 'phel yon khur ro// dgra phywa dgra yi sgra mi grags/ ༈ rdo rje shugs 'gro la bab na// chus phywar skyid sdug re mos byed// khyim phywa na tsha rgyun mi chad// gza' tshes legs par sgo bsgyur zhing*// thab spos lar ni 'bring tsam yin// pho phywa gang byas stabs mi bde// gar bab la zhog 'bring tsam yin// srog phywa bde dang mi bde byed// bya byed ma mang rim gror 'bungs// sngar ni na na de yis thub// yang na nad drag myur du 'byung*// srid phywa 'dre mo zhugs pas ngan// bu chung gson 'dre the'u rang gdon// de bral mi 'chi nad drag 'byung*// nor phywa bor stor 215)rkang bran ngan// lo ma can gyi gzungs la klog /blo phywa bzang min ngan pa'ang min// grogs phywa cung 'ong rngams mi che// sa phywa yul 'dzin 'bring skad do// khang pa byur gyi rgyug srong ngan// zhu ba mchin pa na ba'i rgyu// de bas gzhan du bsgyur na legs// don phya cung 'grub che mi 'grub// mkha' 'gro'-i sems sleb lus mi sleb*// tshong phywa mi rgyal bshol na legs// slob dpon skong yang ngo so med// sman pa 'phral 'phrod phugs mi 'phrod// le'u dud 'gro'i ming btags na// gsos srid gzhan ni 'bring tsam yin// gtar sreg skrag sngang ngo 'dug kyang*// snang brgyad bklags na cung zhig phan// nad par rim gro mdo sde bklag /sats+tsha 'chi bslu gtor chen gtang*// ming spo lus sgyur btsun pa sogs// yin no spang dag gyis dang 'tsho// gdon la pho gdon klu gnod sbyin// de la bdud kyi zhal bsgyur dang*// gnod sbyin gtor ma byin dang phan// bor gtor re ba ma che skad// dmag jag phar rmas tshur shi ngo*// rmig zlum 'phral lji phugs 'gyod la// bcos na lha bsang gyis dang phan// rmig dbrag khra bo brten du rung*// gzhan ni rung tsam ngo so med*// bcos ka gang yang mi 'phrod skad// mdza' bo mi rnyed rnyed kyang byur// gseb btang lan

216)gsum bskyar na chags// mi gsos pas na cung zhig bshol// rtsod pa 'phrod kyang rang mi rgyal// chang ni skyur po dgu ldan 'byung// btso na sum mdor sgyed pu+u'i steng*// sbang ma'i thog la sgo gsum gyi// thal bas g.yog bor the'u rang*// stong sde'i chang thab yin byos la// nang du log nas btsos pas zhim// bzo rigs mi 'phrod ngan skad do// lo legs skya yang mi rgyal la// lo nyes mu ges yang mi rdib/ kha char mi 'bab rlung gis gtor// 'brug glog che yang char mi 'bab// rtsed mo byas pas 'gyod pa skye// skor phywa yon phywa drag rtsub pa'i// bya ba skor dang yon 'phel la// gzhan 'bring rim gros bslu ba tsam// dgra phywa 'phral rtsub phugs nyes chung*/ ༈ rin chen mkha' 'gro la bab na// chus phywa shin tu bzang ba'i rab// khyim phywa bco lngar lha sman mchod// mi tshe skyid la skyel lo skad// pho phywa pho lha dgra bla 'go /ci byas lam du 'gro bas bzang*// srog phywa gza' skang na pa la// shi ba'i 'dres gnod za thang chung*// shi 'dre skrod dang shin tu bzang*// srid phywa pho mo spel mar skye// 'phral bde phugs skyid bzang skad do// bu chung 'phral phug gnyis kar bzang*// nor phywa dzaṃ bha la yis mgon// spyod shes na ni des chog zer/ 217) /blo phywa khyod kyi blo phugs su// kha btsan nor phyug pa yod thang*// yang na rdzas 'od can gyi ngo*// blo kha ma yang dang blo gros// chus ni legs nas 'ong skad do// grogs gcig phyir na gyog gcig 'khor// grogs de mchod sbyin byas na legs// sa dpal bzang ches mi non pas// dbus su mchod rten rgyab dang legs/ khang pa 'pho skyas dog la bzang*// gzhan la mi brtan par 'dug go /zhu ba lha dang bla mas gnang*// mi dpon mi min sogs mi gnang*// don phywa gang bsam 'grub par 'gyur// mgron po nyer 'ong myur du 'gro// tshong phywa 'phral ngan phugs su legs// slob dpon de yi lha srung rnams// mchod dang 'phrod par mchi'o skad// sman pa mi khug khug na 'phrod// le'u 'phrod cing shin tu bzang*// gtar sreg bzang drag dpyad byed khar// nad pa'i glud bzhi phyogs bzhir bor// nad pa 'di la nad gzhi yod// dus la bab min rim gros dpyad// le lo med par btson na ni// 'tsho ba'i gnas skabs 'gyur skad do// gdon ni lha btsan sman mos gnod// lha chog dang ni sman mchod bya// gri bo bkar dang rgyal mdos bya// sder cha nar mar gtong dgos skad// bor stor mi yis khyer ngo yin// thabs kyis byas na lon par 'gyur// dmag jag song na dmag dpon gyi

/rkang 218)chag jag phrug nor dang 'phrad// rmig zlum bde chod bcos na phan// rmig dbrag mi 'phrod bcos mi len// mdza' bo rnyed kyang rnyed lags te// phral du nyams dga' phugs su gyod// gseb 'di'i bar du 'byung po rgyug /zhag 'ga' bsring dang srid phor 'gyur// yang na pho mo'i gzu+ugs glud bor// gzhan dang gtam lab byas na ni// ya rab rnams dang shin tu legs// ma rab rnams dang ngan pas bshol// cha la 'gong po kha sgyur gyis// khyod kyi chang rnams legs par 'gyur// bzo 'di nam yang mi shes so// rtsed mo'i rigs ni brtsam mi bya// lo yang mi legs sad kyis khyer/ kha char chung la thun yun ring*// bskor phywa g.yon phya bzang rab bo// dgra phywa dgra med gnyen dang 'grogs// 'on kyang byis par khrag ngo zhig /'dug pas khrag zor gcig rgyab skad/ ༈ rin chen shugs 'gro la bab na// chus phywar ngan pas brgyad stong brgya// sats+tsha 'bum ther 'chi bslu dang*// spang dag chos skyong gsol ka gzob// khyim phywa ngan pas lam 'phrang bcos// sats+tsha 'chi nges srog bslu dang*// lus sgyur ming spo tshe sgrub dbang*// gser 'od spang kong 'don dang legs// pho phywa chos byas shin tu bzang// de min bla bslu tshe chog dang*// dge slong bzhi sdes gtor bzlog bya// ma grub lo 'khor na 219)ba'am/ yan lag rnams la skyon 'byung nyen// srid phywar sdong rgyan cho ga dang*// mo shing 'thems par glud chas bkon// skyes pa bcu gsum pang bskor byas// rgya gram lam du bor na legs// srog phywar pha myes dur sris gnod// sri mnan gri 'dul drag tu bya// bu chung glud brgya gtsug tor dang*// tshe gzungs bton na mi 'chi tsam// nor phywa 'phel med 'grib pa med// blo phywa rngams chen bshol bar bya// grogs ni phyi dal che ba yin// sa cha sa bdag gdug can gyi// pho brang yin pas nor la ngan/

khang pa'i sa yang bkra mi shis// zhu ba mi dpon blon chen gyis// 'go 'dren yod na gnang bar 'os// don phywa mi 'grub re ma che// mgron po 'ong shing la 'ur 'gro /tshangs phywa phran tsam yin na 'grub// rngams chen yin na bshol na legs// slob dpon 'ong yang 'di mi 'phrod// lha rje kha nyes ci yang med// le'u 'phral 'phrod phugs ngan no// gtar sreg shin tu ngan pas bshol// nad pa myur du gsos par 'gyur// gdon ni rgyal po grwa shor dang*// be har mdos rnams 'phral du gyis// bor stor 'phral rnyed 'dra na yang*// phugs su lag tu 'ong bar dka'// dmag jag la btsas gsos dang legs// rmig zlum 'phral ngan phugs su legs/ bcos ka g.yang skar 220)'phrod na bzang*// rmig dbrag bsten rung bcos ka bshol// mdza' rogs mi 'phrad byur dang 'phrad// gseb btang srid chang shin tu bzang*// gzhan dang gtam lan thabs byas na// 'phrod kyang 'phrod la phugs yang bzang*/ chang phud btsun par drang na zhim// za ring snying dga' dum gcig 'ong*/ lo legs za ba'i snga grab chung*/ kha char cher 'bab 'ob lam 'brug /rtsed mo ngan pas ci nas bshol// bskor g.yon nam langs skar ma 'dra// dgra phywa tshang zla dgra ru longs// dgra shubs gte nag mi kha bzlog khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog bya/ ༈ pad+ma mkha' 'gro la bab na// chus phywa bzang ba'i nang ni rab// khyim phywa phyug kyang chi le bzang*// pho phywa su la btab kyang bzang*// srog phywar bsam pa'i don 'grub bzang*// srid phywa grib 'dzoms bu mo skye// srid 'gugs byas na bu yang skye// klu sman mchod na zas nor 'phel// bu chung ma shi tsam zhig 'ong*// nor phywa che nor rnams la bzang*// rkang phran la ngan g.yang len dang*// sbyin sreg mnan pa byas na dge /blo phywa bshol mi med na bzang*// grogs phywa bsam pa'i don yang 'grub// sa bzung brtan la bkra shis so// khang pa 'phral legs phugs su yang*// stabs legs gyur na legs par srid// zhu ba ci

221)'dod myur du 'byung*// don phywa bsam pa'i don kun 'grub// mgron po yul gzhan zhig tu song*// tshang phywa tshang rgyal nor 'phel lo// slob dpon khug dka' khug na mchog /lha rje 'di rang gcig pus chog /le'u bzang ba'i rtse mo yin// gtar sreg ma 'gyang myur du gyis// nad pa tshe 'gugs srog phur 'dogs// 'phral ma dwangs kyang srog skyon med// gdon ni klu sman gnod pas na// mtsho sman gur mdos klu bcos bya// bor stor myur du lon par gda'// dmag jag lam rgyug dka' ba yin// rmig zlum 'phrod la bcos kyang legs// rmig dbrag btang snyoms stabs dang bstun// mdza' rogs thags thogs med par rnyed// gseb btang srid de mo rgyud 'ong*// lab na rgyal pham snyom pa 'byung*// chang la klu mchod tshos dang zhim// bzo ni legs dka' snang brgyad 'don// lo thog than pas khyer ba dang*/ kha char mi 'bab dal gyis 'bab// rtsed mo 'phral bzang zhag chod ngan// skor phywa g.yang phywa bkra shis 'khyil// dgra phywa dgra med 'dre dang phral/ ༈ /pad+ma byung 'gro la bab na// chus phywa phyi chus zas nor 'phel// bar chus mi bde dgong gshegs che// nang chus mi bde nang rtsod 'byung*// khyim phywa g.yang 'gugs nor lha mchod// klu sman mchod 222)ma legs pa'i ngo*// pho phywar sngags pa 'gras pa'am// gnya' non dgra kun yod na thang*// dgra zon dug zon mthu zon gyis// srog phywa mi 'chi na ngo yod// glud dang chab gtor lha btsun gsol// btsun pas chos skyong bskang gso gyis// srid phywar byis pa sos dka' zhing*// tshe stod mthun yang tshe smad bral// snas sgye khra bor mi kha'i rdzas// bkang ba mar zan kha bcad pa// smrang bcas dwa phrug gcig la skur// bzhi mdor lan lnga bor na phan// bu chung skyong dka' gtso bo'am// chos byas na ni slob dpon 'byung*// nor phywa gang stong shin tu che// blo sna mang yang mgo thon nyung*// grogs phywa 'phral ngan phugs su 'byung*// sa bzung kha smras rgyun mi chad/

khang pa sa yi lte bar phog /zhu ba phyi dal ma song bzang*// don phywa dga' bar 'grub par dka'// mgraun po mi 'ong 'ong bar sems// tshong phywa rngams chen min yang legs// slob dpon byin ldan de spyan drangs// sman pa mi 'phrod shin tu ngan// le'u 'phrod kyang lha gcig dgos// gtar sreg byas kyang phan pa med// nad pa rang mal zhog dang pos// gdon ni ri btsan klu btsan gdon// sha ba'i re 'gyong btsan mdos thongs// bor stor bslus ma bcas te len// dmag jag 'phral thob phugs ni ngan// rmig zlum bcang dang bcos kyang ngan// rmig dbrag 'di ni khyod 223)kyi byur// mdza' po rnyed kyang byur dang bsdong*// gseb btang srid mtsho skam pas ngan// lab na rang gzhan phung bar 'gyur// chang de gzhan dang brjes na yag /bzo rigs shin tu bkra shis so// lo thog bzang med ngan med yin/ kha char 'ong la khad mi 'byung*// rtsed mo 'phral phugs gnyis ka legs// skor phywa skor 'phel g.yon phywa ngan// dgra phywa dgra ngo myur du 'byung*// dgra bzlog mtshon bzlog thabs mchis gyis/ ༈ las kyi mkha' 'gro la babs na/ chus phywa dar drag yun thung ngo*/ khyim phywa la ni me zon dang*/ chung srir yas thong de nas legs// pho phywa lo gcig tshun la legs// de mtshams mya ngan snying stong ngo*// srog phywa lcags bas sra bar 'gyur// srid phywa phun sum tshogs par 'byung*// bu chung mthu phywa shin tu bzang*// nor phywa nor glud skab skab thongs// nor lha gsol dang phyugs 'phel che// blo phywa rgyun bsring zhig dang bzang*// grogs gcig 'dug pa gzhan du song*// sa cha yul bzung 'bring tsam mo/ khang pa tshig gam tshad nad 'byung*// khang mdog khyo sgo khyi dmar bya// zhu ba legs kyang 'dod don chung*// don chung 'grub la che mi 'grub// mgraun po rdul nag tsa re 'ong*// chang ni lhod la gyis dang bzang*// slob dpon bsten na byin rlabs

224)che// sman pas phan las gnod pa che// sman bcos ma byed gto bcos gyis// le'u gzab na gsos kyang srid// gtar sreg mi 'phrod gzhan la sgyur// nad pa bred snga gcig 'ong kyang*// sman dpyad rim 'gro 'bungs dang phan// gdon du gza' rgyal klu ma yams// de rnams cho ga myur du gyis// bor stor thabs mkhas rang lag 'ong*// dmag jag dgra bla gsol na bzang// rmig zlum 'phrod la bcos na legs// rmig dbrag brten bcos rung tsam yin// mdza' rogs 'dre 'dra spros pa chod// gseb btang na ni srid pa chags// lab na rang rgyal gzhan la phan// chang ni 'phral ngan phugs su legs// bzo ni legs la bzo bo ngan// lo legs char than gnyis mi 'byung*// rtsed mo chung yag chen po ngan// skor phywa g.yon phywa bzang ba'i mchog /dgra phywa dgra ni gzhan du song*/ ༈ /las kyi byung 'gro la bab na/ chus phywa dar can mo la bzang*// phal pas chos skyong gsol mchod gyis// khyim phywa sgyed tshugs ma shor tsam// pho phywa phar la phan btags kyang*// tshur la gnod pas rang mgo thon// srog phywa ngan pas mdos zer rigs// brgya bzhi bla bslu lam zam bcos// rim gro mang la myur bar gyis// lo gsum 225)bde yang srid pa yin// srid phywa phun sum tshogs pa'i ngo*// bu chung grwa lnga chung glud bzang*// nor phywa spu rtags can shor na// ngan cing de ma shor na bzang*// blo phywa nyes pas bsogs nor zad// de las bshol na legs skad do// grogs phywa rwa la phar snyabs na// tshur la za le'i bri rkun zug /sa cha phu mda' bar gsum na// lha klu gnyan gsum dar bas bzang*/ khang pa rkun zon gyis dang bzang*// zhu ba ci 'dod gnang bas gda'// don ni myur du 'grub par 'dug /mgron po grogs bcas myur du 'ong*// yang na gtam gsar thos pa'i ngo*// tshangs pham snying khung 'byung bas ngan// slob dpon gzhan la spos na legs// sman pa 'phrod pas myur du khug

/le'u pha ba shin tu bzang*// sman dpyad sder cha thong la gsang*// gyis dang zug chog pa tsam 'ong*// nang pa sgro 'dra rim gro gzab// lam gzhung na sa yin na gsos// gdon ni gza' klu sa bdag dang*// rgyal pos gnod pas de rnams bcos// gzungs 'dus rnams 'joms byab chog bya// bor stor 'phral dka' rtsad 'byung ste// lag tu 'ong bar dka' bar mchis// dmag jag mi rgyal brtsam mi byed// rmig zlum brten rung bcos mi nyan// rmig dbrag 'phral phan phugs su legs// bcos ka mus kyis 'phrod par 'gyur// mdza' rogs sngar 'dris 'phrad par mchis/ 226) /gsar pa rnyed dka' rnyed kyang ngan// gseb btang chags par mi 'gyur ro// lab na 'phrod la dge yang dge /chang ni thengs shig mi zhim skad// bzo rigs gang byed legs mi 'gyur// lo ni mi legs nyes skad do/ kha char shin tu che bar 'bab// rtsed mo 'phral phugs gang yang dge /skor phywa yon phywa bzang la legs// dgra phywa dgra med dgra gcig ni// sang phod tsam mam lo gcig la// mi khyod la ni dgra mi 'ong*/

bzhi pa ni/ gtor 'bul ye shes rten la bstim// dge rtsa bsngo zhing shis pa brjod// 'di ni yig tshogs bsdus pa ste// zhib par gter gzhung nyid la ltos// rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs kyi mdzod gcig pu// dgongs 'dus gter chos yid bzhin nor bu 'di// skyed dang tshe rabs kun tu 'dzin nus shing*// pad+ma'i bstan la bya ba byed par shog zhes pa'ang nye gnas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bzhed skong du dgongs 'dus la mos pa rig 'dzin dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// sarba maṅga lam//
